name: Neon Spread
description: A diagonal lattice of fine black rules colored only where they cross, so soft discs of color seem to glow at every crossing.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(-9% -3%, -3% -9%, 50% 44%, 103% -9%, 109% -3%, 56% 50%, 109% 103%, 103% 109%, 50% 56%, -3% 109%, -9% 103%, 44% 50%); clip-path: polygon(-9% -3%, -3% -9%, 50% 44%, 103% -9%, 109% -3%, 56% 50%, 109% 103%, 103% 109%, 50% 56%, -3% 109%, -9% 103%, 44% 50%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round((20 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((20 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% at 50% 50%, transparent 0 100%, #000 100%); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round((20 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((20 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% at 50% 50%, transparent 0 100%, #000 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(-9% -3%, -3% -9%, 50% 44%, 103% -9%, 109% -3%, 56% 50%, 109% 103%, 103% 109%, 50% 56%, -3% 109%, -9% 103%, 44% 50%); clip-path: polygon(-9% -3%, -3% -9%, 50% 44%, 103% -9%, 109% -3%, 56% 50%, 109% 103%, 103% 109%, 50% 56%, -3% 109%, -9% 103%, 44% 50%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round((20 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((20 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% at 50% 50%, #000 0 100%, transparent 100%); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round((20 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((20 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% at 50% 50%, #000 0 100%, transparent 100%);
